title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Terms: Purchases Eligible for Crew Delivery and Open Appointments
content:
Northgate Delivery & Installation crews deliver only purchases made as a Northgate In-Club Purchase or a Northgate Special Order. Orders on the other channels are fulfilled by pickup, the delivery partner, parcel carriers or the business delivery routes and are never booked as a Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment.

## 1. Status of the purchase

1.1 A delivery is booked only for a purchase whose status is placed, or fulfilled when the appointment is a free workmanship revisit of an earlier installation.

1.2 The status is read from the purchase record itself, matched to the purchase being booked; a member's description of the purchase does not stand in for that record.

| Purchase status on the record | Appointment being booked | Booked under this rule |
|---|---|---|
| Placed | Any appointment | Yes |
| Fulfilled | A free workmanship revisit of an earlier installation | Yes |
| Fulfilled | Any other appointment | No |
| Any other status | Any appointment | No |

## 2. One open appointment per service level

2.1 A purchase may not have two open appointments at the same service level.

2.2 An appointment is open while its status is scheduled, out for delivery or attempt failed. A completed or cancelled appointment is not open.

2.3 Merchandise to be added to an open appointment is added to it rather than booked again.

The open appointments are read from the appointment records of the same purchase at the same service level.

## Hypothetical cases

- A purchase is placed and already has a Northgate Room of Choice Delivery appointment whose status is scheduled. Another Room of Choice appointment for the same purchase is not booked; merchandise for it is added to the scheduled appointment.
- The same purchase's earlier Room of Choice appointment is completed. That appointment is no longer open, so the one-open-appointment rule does not stand in the way of another Room of Choice appointment for the purchase; the status rule in clause 1.1 still applies.
- An order placed as a Northgate.com ship-to-home order is not on a delivered channel and is never booked here.
